description: Domain modeling skills for Claude Code: software archetype mappers (accounting, pricing), an archetype scanner, an archetype skill builder, and a bounded-context distiller.

plugins.name: archetype-modeling
plugins.description: Map domain requirements onto software archetypes and distill bounded contexts. Includes the accounting and pricing (valuation) archetype mappers, a parallel scanner that tests requirements against every known archetype, a builder that extracts new mapper skills from reference implementations and training material, and a context distiller that finds safe generalizations across domain concepts.
